key_insight: A constrained treasury allocation problem can be reformulated as a QUBO and solved on IBM quantum hardware with the same optimal result as a classical solver for a small proof-of-concept instance.
engineering_relevance: This shows that near-term quantum devices can execute realistic financial optimization workflows, offering a pathway for future hybrid optimization tools in treasury and risk operations.
method: Formulated the Color-of-Money problem as a constrained MILP.
Converted the MILP into a QUBO for quantum execution.
Used a VQA with Pauli Correlation Encoding and error mitigation on IBM hardware.
evidence_signal: On a prototype instance with 3 assets, 3 obligations, and 2 time periods, the quantum result matched the classical SCIP optimum.
watch_item: The study is limited to a very small instance, so current noisy hardware does not yet demonstrate an advantage over classical optimization.
paper_title: Quantum Optimization of the Color-of-Money Problem on IBM Quantum Hardware: A Proof-of-Concept Study
